value.rationale: Numerical squared-norm estimates should be nonnegative, yet the newly proposed optimal-query nonadaptive estimator has an intrinsic sign-support failure for every nonzero input at any positive correction weight. The exact tail law shows the event is exponentially rare, quantifies the rate and leading probability, and determines the nontrivial e^-2 reduction from the published oracle variance-optimal weight. This measures a meaningful reliability/variance tradeoff, not merely a negative numerical example.
